item.text:
Completed the pricing decision migration and subscription version changes.

The migration selects the fee effective on the approval date, falls back to the legacy fee or minimum fee when needed, and rejects negative imported fees with SQLSTATE `P0001` without changing existing data. New subscription versions retain their other terms and require a fresh pricing decision.

Validation passed: `bun test` passed all three tests, and PostgreSQL 18 checks confirmed fee selection, fallback behavior, and rollback on a negative fee.
